digest.component_or_area: CLI author guides and commit-trailer documentation
propositions: CLI-served packaged guides contain dangling consumer-relative cross-references (review-policy.md, CONTRIBUTING.md, docs/ paths) that fail for repo-less clients
The commit-trailer format (EXPECTED_FORMAT from verify_commit.py) has no CLI-discoverable home; it is only documented in --help output with no pointer from discoverable guides

Packaged guides must repoint all internal references to either sibling guides via `rebar explain <topic>` or to hosted canonical URLs (https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/blob/main/…) to resolve for clients without a rebar checkout
A new packaged guide commit-ticket-trailer.md must be registered in AUTHOR_GUIDES and served via `rebar explain commit-trailer`
A link-resolution guard test must validate that no packaged guide contains consumer-relative paths, bare repo paths, or dead `rebar explain` references
